`forecast.json` is a shortened Open-Meteo Forecast API response for Kofu
(35.6667, 138.55), retrieved on 2026-10-25. Only the first three hourly values
and first daily values are retained. Time format is Unix seconds and the
daily timezone is Asia/Tokyo. Source: [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/),
CC BY 4.0. This is a parser fixture, not a current forecast.
